verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag platform, so stale-flag cleanup is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never documents stale-flag detection, flag lifecycle status, or code-reference scanning. Gate exposure monitoring and CLI/Console API gate management are related features, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase
